summary: Backend + frontend regression for BESLENCE AI onboarding/activity refactor. Backend (19/19 passing): POST /api/profile now always uses BMR×1.20 regardless of daily_activity_level/sports_frequency. Verified the spec example: erkek/30/180/75/yag_yakmak → BMR=1730, maintenance=2076, factor=1.2, goal_calories_min=1765 (2076*0.85), goal_calories_max=1868 (2076*0.90). Two identical profiles with cok_hareketsiz vs cok_aktif both produce maintenance=2076 (factor unchanged). GET /api/summary/daily aggregates estimated_activity_burn_min/max correctly (returns 200/300+ for the seeded activity day) and returns 0 burn for an unrelated date. Frontend (Expo web preview, 390×844): splash auto-routes to /welcome ~5s after load when not logged in. /welcome shows 'Hoş geldin' title, subtitle, description card, and both CTAs (welcome-start-button, welcome-existing-button) with correct testIDs. 'Başlayalım' navigates to /auth?next=onboarding with Google sign-in visible. Legacy onboarding paths redirect correctly: /onboarding/activity→/theme, /onboarding/sport→/theme, /onboarding/info→/name, /onboarding/measurements→/waist. All 10 new onboarding screens (goal→name→age→sex→height→weight→target-weight→waist→theme→privacy) render the correct 'N/10' progress counter and contain NO activity-related questions.

ui_bugs.issue: On /onboarding/privacy the '10/10' label wraps to '10/1' + '0' on two lines because the badge container is too narrow for two-digit/two-digit numerator+denominator. Reference: /app/frontend/app/onboarding/privacy.tsx (step counter component, likely in scaffold).

issues: Large vertical gap between description card and CTAs at 390×844 — visually empty middle. Consider tightening or adding an illustration.

react_native_issues.issue: Console deprecation warnings: 'shadow* style props are deprecated, use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated, use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/AnimatedBLogo.tsx and PrimaryButton/theme shadow styles.

action_items: (Low) Fix the step badge so '10/10' renders on one line on /onboarding/privacy (width/letter-spacing in OnboardingScaffold).
(Low) Replace pointerEvents prop with style.pointerEvents in AnimatedBLogo to silence the RN deprecation warning.
(Low) Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow in PrimaryButton/theme to silence RN web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend calc_plan now correctly ignores ACTIVITY_FACTOR dictionary (kept only for backward compatibility); BASE_FACTOR=1.20 is hard-coded. Profile model still accepts daily_activity_level/sports_frequency but they are no longer used — acceptable for backward compatibility with stored documents.
Legacy onboarding routes (activity.tsx, sport.tsx, info.tsx, measurements.tsx) are pure <Redirect> components — clean implementation that preserves deep-link safety.
